name: Kristina Dino
bio:
Kristina is a dual board-certified Nurse Practitioner specializing in medical weight loss, aesthetic medicine and wellness optimization. She earned her MSN and a post-master's certification in psychiatric mental health from West Coast University.

She leads our weight-management work — evidence-based fat loss, metabolic health and lifestyle change — and is a trained injector with an emphasis on natural-looking, refreshed results.
